title: O melhor de tudo
theme: Superlativos e ordinais — destacar o melhor, o pior, o primeiro
goal: Aluno sai sabendo usar superlativos (-est, the most), irregulares (best/worst) e ordinais (first/second/third) pra rankings e destaques.
connects_to: M14 (Onde estive ontem) — depois de destacar o melhor, fala do passado com was/were.
module_chunks: the + adj-est (the tallest, the biggest, the easiest)
the most + long adj (the most expensive, the most interesting)
first, second, third, fourth, fifth, tenth, twentieth, last
in the world / in my class / in my family
of all / by far the + superlative

units.title: O mais alto, o maior
units.real_life_context: Você destaca o mais alto, o maior, o mais barato da família, da turma, do bairro.

grammar.explanation: Superlativo curto: "the + adj-est". "The tallest" — destaca o máximo entre um grupo.

grammar.sentence: This is _____ phone in the store.
Today is _____ day of the year.
This is _____ exam of the semester.
São Paulo is _____ city in Brazil.
grammar.explanation: "Big" → "biggest" (dobra o g). "The biggest city in Brazil".

grammar.sentence: He is tallest in our class.
grammar.answer: He is the tallest in our class.
grammar.explanation: Superlativo SEMPRE com "the": "THE tallest". Sem "the" é erro comum.
"Short" (1 sílaba) → "the shortest" (com -est). Não "the most short" (que seria pra long adj).

grammar.passage: My brother is the tallest in our family. My sister is the youngest. I'm the oldest. We all live in the biggest house on the street.
grammar.question: Who is the tallest?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "My brother is the tallest".

listening_speaking.text: She is the youngest in the family.
São Paulo is the biggest city in Brazil.

roleplay.scenario: Charlotte pede pra você destacar O máximo de coisas — da família, cidade, time.
roleplay.opening_line: Who's the tallest in your family?

objectives.label_pt: Destacar o mais alto/jovem/velho da família
objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'the + short adj-est + in/of + family/group'

objectives.label_pt: Destacar o maior/mais barato/mais quente de um grupo

objectives.hint_pt: It's the hottest day of the year.
objectives.hint_en: It's the hottest day of the year.

roleplay.closing_cue: Charlotte fecha com "Strong superlatives!" quando obj_3 baterem.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "Who's the tallest in your family?"
2. **Student**: ~"My brother is the tallest."
3. **Charlotte**: "Cheapest store you know?"
4. **Student**: ~"This is the cheapest store."
5. **Charlotte**: "Hottest day this year?"
6. **Student**: ~"It's the hottest day of the year."
7. **Charlotte**: "Strong superlatives!"

guided_chat.intro_pt: Charlotte explora rankings na sua vida. Pratica 'the + adj-est'.
guided_chat.opening_message: Tell me three superlatives about your world.

objectives.hint_pt: I'm the oldest in my family.
objectives.hint_en: I'm the oldest in my family.

objectives.hint_pt: São Paulo is the biggest city.
objectives.hint_en: São Paulo is the biggest city.

guided_chat.closing_cue: Charlotte encerra com "Top of the list!" quando obj_3 baterem.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 7 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "Tell me three superlatives about your world."
2. **Student**: "I'm the oldest in my family."
3. **Charlotte**: "Big sibling energy. City?"
4. **Student**: "São Paulo is the biggest city."
5. **Charlotte**: "Massive."
6. **Student**: "How about you?"
7. **Charlotte**: "NYC is the busiest. Top of the list!"

> N01 chat = LLM puro.

units.title: O mais interessante
units.grammar_focus: Superlatives with long adjectives (the most + adj)
units.real_life_context: Você destaca o mais interessante, mais caro, mais bonito de uma lista ou categoria.

grammar.sentence: This is _____ movie of the year.
grammar.explanation: Adjetivo longo → "the most + adj". "The most interesting", não "interestingest".

grammar.sentence: She is _____ person in the room.
grammar.explanation: "Beautiful" → "the most beautiful". Long adj sempre com "most".

grammar.sentence: She is _____ teacher in the school.

grammar.explanation: "Popular" → "the most popular". Sempre "most" antes de adj longo.

grammar.sentence: This is _____ book in the library.

grammar.answer: He is the most interesting person.
grammar.explanation: "Interestingest" não existe. Sempre "the most interesting" pra adj longo.
Superlativo sempre com "THE": "the most beautiful". Sem "the" é erro.

grammar.passage: This is the most expensive restaurant in town. The food is the most delicious in the city. The service is also the most professional.
grammar.question: How is the service?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "The service is also the most professional".

listening_speaking.text: This is the most interesting book.
She is the most beautiful person.
Paris is the most expensive city.
He is the most patient teacher.

roleplay.scenario: Charlotte pede superlativos com adjetivos longos — opiniões fortes.
roleplay.opening_line: What is the most interesting place in your city?

objectives.hint_pt: Yoga is the most interesting hobby.
objectives.hint_en: Yoga is the most interesting hobby.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'the most + long adj + noun'
objectives.hint_pt: Rome is the most beautiful city.
objectives.hint_en: Rome is the most beautiful city.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses another 'the most + long adj'
objectives.hint_pt: She is the most patient person.
objectives.hint_en: She is the most patient person.

roleplay.closing_cue: Charlotte fecha com "Big opinions!" quando obj_3 baterem.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "What is the most interesting place in your city?"
2. **Student**: ~"Yoga is the most interesting hobby."
3. **Charlotte**: "Most beautiful place?"
4. **Student**: ~"Rome is the most beautiful city."
5. **Charlotte**: "Most patient person you know?"
6. **Student**: ~"She is the most patient person."
7. **Charlotte**: "Big opinions!"

guided_chat.intro_pt: Charlotte explora os 'mais' da sua vida. Pratica 'the most + long adj'.
guided_chat.opening_message: What's the most expensive thing you own?

objectives.hidden_prompt: user says 'My + thing + is the most expensive'
objectives.hint_pt: My phone is the most expensive.
objectives.hint_en: My phone is the most expensive.

objectives.hint_pt: Travel is the most exciting thing.
objectives.hint_en: Travel is the most exciting thing.

guided_chat.closing_cue: Charlotte encerra com "Big league answers!" quando obj_3 baterem.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 7 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "What's the most expensive thing you own?"
2. **Student**: "My phone is the most expensive."
3. **Charlotte**: "Common one. Exciting?"
4. **Student**: "Travel is the most exciting thing."
5. **Charlotte**: "Same."
6. **Student**: "How about you?"
7. **Charlotte**: "Books are the most precious to me. Big league answers!"

> N02 chat = LLM puro.

units.title: O melhor, o pior
units.grammar_focus: Irregular superlatives (the best, the worst, the most/least)
units.real_life_context: Você destaca o melhor e o pior em listas de favoritos.

grammar.sentence: Today is _____ day of the week.
She is _____ player in the team.
grammar.explanation: "The best" — irregular superlativo de "good". Sempre com "the".

grammar.sentence: This is _____ movie of the year.
He is _____ teacher in the school.
grammar.explanation: "The best" — superlativo de "good". Decora a lista: good/better/best.
"The most ideas" = mais ideias. "The most + noun" pra quantidades.

grammar.sentence: Today is the more bad day.

grammar.passage: Ana is the best singer in our class. Lucas is the worst at math but the best at art. We all agree — she has the most talent.
grammar.question: Who is the best at art?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "Lucas is... the best at art".

roleplay.scenario: Charlotte pede destaques — o melhor e o pior da sua vida ou cidade.
roleplay.opening_line: Best and worst — give me yours!

objectives.label_pt: Dizer o melhor de algo (the best)
objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'the best + noun' or 'X is the best'
objectives.hint_pt: This is the best pizza in town.
objectives.hint_en: This is the best pizza in town.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'the worst + noun' or 'X is the worst'

roleplay.closing_cue: Charlotte fecha com "Strong picks!" quando obj_3 baterem.

2. **Student**: ~"This is the best pizza in town."
3. **Charlotte**: "Worst day?"
4. **Student**: ~"Mondays are the worst."
5. **Charlotte**: "Most talented person?"
6. **Student**: ~"She has the most talent."
7. **Charlotte**: "Strong picks!"

guided_chat.scenario: Charlotte conversa sobre rankings de favoritos e piores.
guided_chat.intro_pt: Charlotte abre chat sobre favoritos e piores. Pratica irregulares de superlativo.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user says 'The best meal was + X' or 'X is the best meal'

guided_chat.closing_cue: Charlotte encerra com "Bests and worsts done!" quando obj_3 baterem.
guided_chat.suggested_script:

units.title: Primeiro, segundo, terceiro
units.real_life_context: Você ordena coisas em sequência — andares, posições, datas, listas.

grammar.explanation: Ordinais têm formas especiais: 3 = "three", 3rd = "third" (não "threeth"). Decorar: 1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third.

grammar.sentence: The party is on the _____ of December.
grammar.explanation: 25th = "twenty-fifth". Compostos seguem padrão: 5 + th = fifth (não fifteenth). Datas usam ordinais.

grammar.sentence: January is the _____ month of the year.
She is in her _____ year of university.
My birthday is on the threeth.
grammar.answer: My birthday is on the third.

grammar.passage: I live on the second floor. My birthday is on the fourth of July. This is my first time in NYC.
grammar.question: When is the birthday?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "My birthday is on the fourth of July".

listening_speaking.text: I live on the third floor.
My birthday is on the fifteenth.

roleplay.scenario: Charlotte pergunta posições, andares e datas — você usa ordinais.
roleplay.opening_line: Tell me about a few orders — floor, time, date.

objectives.label_pt: Dizer em que andar você mora (ordinal)
objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'I live on the + ordinal + floor'
objectives.hint_pt: I live on the third floor.
objectives.hint_en: I live on the third floor.

objectives.label_pt: Dizer 'é minha primeira/segunda vez fazendo algo'
objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'It's my + ordinal + time + verb-ing'
user uses 'on the + ordinal + of + month' for a date
objectives.hint_pt: My birthday is on the fifteenth.
objectives.hint_en: My birthday is on the fifteenth.

roleplay.closing_cue: Charlotte fecha com "Ordered!" quando obj_3 baterem.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "Tell me about a few orders — floor, time, date."
2. **Student**: ~"I live on the third floor."
3. **Charlotte**: "First time doing something cool?"
4. **Student**: ~"It's my first time visiting."
5. **Charlotte**: "A date?"
6. **Student**: ~"My birthday is on the fifteenth."
7. **Charlotte**: "Ordered!"

guided_chat.scenario: Charlotte conversa sobre primeiros, segundos e ordens.
guided_chat.intro_pt: Charlotte abre chat sobre ordens (primeiro, segundo, etc.). Pratica ordinais.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'It's my + ordinal + time' or 'No, second/third time'
user asks 'How about you?' or 'When is your...?'

guided_chat.closing_cue: Charlotte encerra com "Order achieved!" quando obj_3 baterem.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 7 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "First time in Brazil?"
2. **Student**: "It's my first time."
3. **Charlotte**: "Cool. Cup of coffee?"
4. **Student**: "This is my second coffee."
5. **Charlotte**: "Caffeine fan."
6. **Student**: "How about you?"
7. **Charlotte**: "Third coffee today. Order achieved!"

units.title: Rankings completos
units.real_life_context: Você ranqueia coisas da sua vida — melhores, piores e por ordem.

grammar.sentence: This is _____ movie of the year.
He is _____ player on the team.

grammar.explanation: "My first time in NYC" — primeira visita. Ordinal especial.

grammar.sentence: São Paulo is _____ city in Brazil.

grammar.passage: I live on the third floor. My building is the tallest in the neighborhood. This is the best apartment in the building. The view is the most beautiful.
grammar.question: How is the view?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "The view is the most beautiful".

listening_speaking.text: She is the tallest in the team.
I live on the third floor.

roleplay.scenario: Charlotte pede três rankings — superlativo curto, longo, irregular ou ordinal.
roleplay.opening_line: Three rankings — superlatives or ordinals, your pick!

objectives.label_pt: Usar um superlativo longo ou irregular
objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'the most + long adj' OR 'the best/worst'

roleplay.closing_cue: Charlotte fecha com "Top tier rankings!" quando obj_3 baterem.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "Three rankings — superlatives or ordinals, your pick!"
2. **Student**: ~"My brother is the tallest."
3. **Charlotte**: "Best?"
4. **Student**: ~"This is the best coffee."
5. **Charlotte**: "Ordinal?"
6. **Student**: ~"It's my first time here."
7. **Charlotte**: "Top tier rankings!"

guided_chat.scenario: Charlotte conversa sobre os "top" e ordens da sua vida.
guided_chat.intro_pt: Charlotte abre chat sobre rankings finais. Integra superlativo + ordinal.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user uses 'the best + noun' or 'X is the best'

guided_chat.closing_cue: Charlotte encerra com "Mastered the rankings!" quando obj_3 baterem.
guided_chat.suggested_script:

cross_unit_consolidation: Superlativos curtos: the tallest, the biggest, the easiest
Superlativos longos: the most expensive, the most interesting
Irregulares: the best, the worst, the most/least
Ordinais: first, second, third, fifth, twentieth
Sem misturar "the most tall" ou "the goodest"
